snippet.title: One Shot Gladiator - GMTK 2019 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Play it for free at Itch.io: 
https://firetotemgames.itch.io/one-shot-gladiator

=====================================================

Survive! You only have one shot per weapon. Survive! That's your only thought. Survive! You don't know why, you only know that they want to kill you. How did you get on this situation? You don't remember. The only thought in your head is that you have to survive.

One Shot Gladiator is a game developed for the GMTK Game Jam 2019 together with Firetotem Games and Chris Kennedy, and it was made in just 48 hours.

=====================================================
Learn more about it: https://www.kildergamedev.com/

Follow me on Twitter: https://twitter.com/kilderdev

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/kildert

=====================================================

Sebastian Uitz - Game design, programming and Special Effects

Kilder Távora - Game design, art and animations

Chris Kennedy - Music and Sound Effects
